Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-06

1. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
Google released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a new AI model that can generate and edit 15‑second video clips directly, delivering smoother, more consistent results.

2. GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
OpenAI released GPT‑6 Cyber, a specialized AI trained to identify exploitable software vulnerabilities and generate remediation code, with built‑in safeguards to keep its actions within a predefined, authorized scope.

3. Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
Merge integrated OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex into its internal platforms, using them to automatically review product code, generate marketing copy, and even plan executive dinners and sales updates.
